description:
NinjaTrader 8 is running on the Windows desktop with real daily OHLCV data already imported for SPY, AAPL, and MSFT (January 2023 through December 2024, 502 trading days from Yahoo Finance).

A technical analyst needs to compare AAPL and MSFT side by side with different indicator overlays to evaluate their relative technical setups.

Your task: Create two separate chart windows, each with daily bars and specific technical indicators:

Chart 1 — AAPL:
- 50-period Simple Moving Average (SMA) overlaid on price
- 200-period Simple Moving Average (SMA) overlaid on price
- Volume displayed in a sub-panel

Chart 2 — MSFT:
- 20-period Exponential Moving Average (EMA) overlaid on price
- Bollinger Bands with Period=20 and Standard Deviations=2
- MACD with Fast=12, Slow=26, Signal=9 in a sub-panel

Both charts should be visible on screen simultaneously. Save the workspace when complete.

Login credentials: Docker / GymAnything123!
